prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Right-click your pet anywhere on screen to open controls, hide to tray, or start chatting.", "Quick Controls: Right-click for Menu | Drag to Move | Double-click to Chat"]
1: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet Progress", "Linking your account ensures your pet, items, and settings are backed up to the cloud and will not reset.", "Cloud Pet Recovery Enabled", "Continue with Account"]
2: ["Essential Desktop Controls", "Learn how to hide, drag, and interact with your pet on your desktop.", "Got It!"]
3: []
4: ["Choose Your Adoption Journey", "Select a fast-track companion or create a customized pet from photos."]
5: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your pet creation is guaranteed. If custom rendering runs into any issue, a high-quality companion will automatically be assigned.", "Your pet details are safely stored to your account profile."]
6: ["Preparing Desktop Renderer...", "Verifying screen compatibility and placing pet on your desktop space."]
7: ["Complete onboarding now to receive a free Exclusive Starter Accessory Set!", "Bonus: 3 Free Starter Toys Included"]
8: ["Spawning Pet on Desktop", "We will notify you as soon as your pet appears on your desktop screen."]
9: ["Custom Pet Quality Check", "Reviewing photo contrast and facial features to ensure optimal 3D desktop rendering.", "Confirm & Generate Pet"]

verdicts.problem: Offers free extras/gifts and creates urgency to complete onboarding.
